scope: 17 selected environment materials; 81 wall UV/seam meshes and one wood debris mesh

validation.scope: Resource reload, material dimensions, shared external textures, poster V, roof layers/weather, retained topology/normals within packed tolerance, bounded welds and untouched non-wood triangles

notes: Reviewer scores are subjective. Views use isolated native scenery and fixed dry/wet/night lighting. Legacy specialised debris cells and unchanged architectural silhouettes remain outside approval.

userAcceptance.reason: Sharper textures did not satisfy high-detail environment requirements. Exposed architecture and rails remain sharp, wear and connected wall/ground weathering are insufficient, and a kerb/wall intersection is suspected.
required: Real rounded and worn stone/metal edge geometry
Inspect and correct pavement, kerb, wall and stair junctions
Verify native gutter/downpipe presence, visibility and connected drainage
Coherent wall-foot grime, damp and corresponding pavement staining
Moss and small plants located by persistent wetness, cracks and neglect
Contextual native-game review under updated art-direction rules
